description: Open jobs at a company, from its own applicant tracking system's public job board: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, BambooHR, Personio, Teamtailor, or Workday from a careers URL. Give a company name, website or job-board URL, with optional title, location and remote filters. Returns the newest 50 matching jobs with title, department, location, remote flag, salary when published, posting date and apply link, plus total counts. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

company.description: Company name (stripe), website (stripe.com) or job-board URL (https://jobs.lever.co/palantir)

location.description: Keep jobs whose location, country or workplace type contains this text (london, remote)

remote.description: true keeps only jobs marked remote

title.description: Keep jobs whose title contains this text; comma-separate alternatives (engineer,developer)

name: company_jobs
